en-US.longDescription:
BestNotes EHR for therapy, behavioral health, and addiction treatment

Our EHR solution is designed to support therapy, behavioral health, and addiction treatment providers with a comprehensive suite of features. With efficient documentation to streamlined billing, BestNotes empowers solo practices to large behavioral health organizations to deliver high-quality, patient-centered care.
